text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or extra checks. Input validation is equally important, because it stops harmful data from entering the system. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and follow best practices to prevent them. By focusing on these areas, developers can build safer websites and protect both users and their personal information from online threats.
